title: look_l1_test feeds world-px band values into congested_halo_width's screen-px parameter at scaled rungs
evidence: view.odin:724: `congested_halo_width :: proc(band_screen, scale: f32) -> f32 {` | view.odin:993: `band := link_width_capped(v, topo, bundles, u32(bi)) * v.scale` | look_l1_test.odin:277: `{3.5, 1.4, "Distribution"},` | look_l1_test.odin:292: `// engages at Core fit (8.5 -> 12) and Distribution (11.9 -> 16.8);` | look_l1_test.odin:293: `// Access keeps its classic bump only when it clears the floor.`
detail: Production passes SCREEN band (world x scale); rows {3.5,1.4}/{4.5,2.0} pass the WORLD width 3.5/4.5. The comment's 11.9 assumes screen band 4.9, and 'Access keeps its classic bump' contradicts its own row (19<24, floor wins). Results coincide only because the floor dominates.
recommended_fix: Feed screen bands (3.5*1.4, 4.5*2.0) in the scaled rows, add one bump-dominant row at scale>1, and correct the 11.9/Access comment lines.

title: palcheck section-8 end-cap leak scan can never fail (halo cap renders under the node sprite)
evidence: palcheck.odin:1387: `capa8 := rnd.node_screen(&view, {4, 12}) // an END-CAP column (the halo's endpoint circle — a mid-column-only scan can't see a cap leak)` | palcheck.odin:1455: `n_cap_leak := scan_col_v(img, int(capa8.x), int(capa8.y), floor_px, amber8, 10) + scan_col_v(img, int(capa8.x), int(capa8.y), floor_px, red8, 10)` | view.odin:508: `// draw_world :: the world pass: map -> bundles(pipes) -> nodes -> packets ->`
detail: Nodes draw after bundles, so the halo end-cap circle at the node center is covered by the sprite; the capa8 column reads sprite pixels, never halo. A calm width-leak would paint steel, not the scanned amber/red blends. n_cap_leak==0 always — vacuous by the section's own standard.
recommended_fix: Scan a column just outside the node sprite rim for steel run > band width (catches a width leak), or drop the capa8 term and keep the mid-column checks.
